_criteriaResults_comment: WCAG 2.2 A/AA criteria YOU assessed. Fail rows are filled in automatically from findings — list only Pass, N/A, and Needs manual check here (or a Fail with a note if no finding covers it). Anything not listed shows as Not tested. Never mark Pass for a criterion you didn't check. Omit the field entirely to skip it; Appendix D still appears if any finding cites a WCAG criterion.
